method_source.authors: Barbara Swanson, Jennifer Bain, Kate Helsen, Jan Koláček, Debra Lacoste, Alessandra Ignesti
method_source.scope: Basic entry pp.2–6: clef, pitch, syllable/neume alignment, line breaks, custos exclusion and uncertain-neume retention; relevant figures visually checked.

selection: Start with Dolor cessit cum surrexit and one internal petition phrase if readable. Keep both successes and disagreements; do not extend opportunistically to obtain identity. Record any curtailed coverage explicitly.
tests: Inspect each source clef and local staff lines; keep source-pixel notehead positions and literal underlay distinct from inferred pitch.
Transcribe each source separately before programmatic comparison. Mark uncertain clefs, pitches, note counts or syllable alignment; never normalize away variants.
Exclude custodes from sounded-note counts; do not infer modern rhythm, chromatic inflection or an entire melody from an excerpt.
Compare absolute diatonic labels only if clefs are secure. Otherwise compare explicitly limited staff-step contours, with transposition and ambiguity disclosed.
Test alternate clef interpretation and note segmentation before accepting a disagreement. A shared standard melody or version cannot establish same codex, date or copying direction.
resources: Existing local source images only; no new download, model training, upload, outreach or publication.
frozen_inputs: Preserve the five experiment files, core fragments and MPO metadata hashes.
